name: Decoy's own data
note: Not fetched from anywhere: this is original content, written for this project and
distributed under the same licence as the code. It is the deliberate exception to the
rule that no data here is hand-edited, and it exists because some fields have no
registry to cite -- nobody publishes an authoritative list of car manufacturers, or
bicycle types, or the words people use for colours.
The rule that stops this becoming a dumping ground is in the adapter: try to cite
first. Four rounds of searching moved counties, subdivisions, phone formats, name
patterns, HTTP status codes, JOSE algorithms, Latin vocabulary and job titles out of
this category and into real sources. Only what survives that search is written here.
English only. These are not translations -- a locale without its own data falls through
to English, which is already what happens for wordnet vocabulary and occupations.
Inventing a German list would be inventing German.
Carries no artifact because there is nothing to fetch and no integrity hash because
there is no upstream to verify against. The content is in the repository, reviewable in
a diff, which is a stronger guarantee than a hash over somebody else's server.
